quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (January-December 2025) results: net sales JPY 311,402 million (up 4.1%), operating profit JPY 34,131 million (up 457.6%; operating margin 11.0% versus 2.0%), ordinary profit JPY 37,740 million (up 203.9%) and profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 29,616 million (up 144.9%). Electronics & Information Technology sales JPY 173,751 million (up 10.3%; 55.8% of sales) and Performance Materials JPY 137,651 million (down 2.8%). Management states display sales rose on steady demand throughout the year and higher selling prices, electronic device sales rose on strong demand centred on products for semiconductors and data centers, and composites sales fell on a severe competitive environment and the halt of the UK subsidiary's operations under structural reform; operating profit rose on display productivity improvement and price increases, higher electronic device sales, composites profit-improvement efforts and lower logistics costs. Production value JPY 312,390 million (111.4% of the prior year, calculated at average selling prices); the company basically produces to forecast.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 311,402 million (+4.1%); operating profit JPY 34,131 million (+457.6%); Electronics & Information Technology JPY 173,751 million (+10.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook in the annual securities report (filed March 26, 2026), with the FY2026 forecast published February 6, 2026: net sales JPY 320 billion (H1 JPY 150 billion), operating profit JPY 33 billion (margin 10.3%), ordinary profit JPY 33 billion, profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 23 billion. Management expects steady display demand; in electronic devices, competition in semiconductor support glass is becoming increasingly severe, but expanding sales of probe card substrates and data-center products are expected to lift the business's total sales; in composites, severe competition in functional resin reinforcement is expected to continue while the company works on capacity expansion and sales growth of low-dielectric glass fiber; display costs for rolling out all-electric melting facilities and productivity improvement are expected to rise.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 forecast (February 6): net sales JPY 320 billion; operating profit JPY 33 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: EGP2028 progress by business (annual securities report): electronic devices - expanding sales of semiconductor-related products (support glass for semiconductors, probe card substrates), developing inorganic core substrates (GC Core and glass core substrate), early commercialization of products for growth fields such as panel-type semiconductor support glass and inorganic core substrates, and expanding high-value-added businesses including through M&A; displays - all-electric melting adopted at just under 70% (as of end-December 2025), expanding production of high-heat-resistance low-thermal-shrinkage glass substrates, and raising share in China with large Gen 10.5 substrates; composites - development and sales start of D2 low-dielectric glass fiber and development of low-expansion glass fiber. In FY2025 the company also developed and began selling a fluorine-free (PFAS-free) coating technology. The UK glass fiber subsidiary stopped production in June 2025.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 R&D expenses JPY 8,810 million (R&D division JPY 3,391 million, manufacturing divisions JPY 5,419 million). Themes stated: glass thin films for next-generation memory supporting the AI society; high-performance optical isolators using glass with about twice the magneto-optical properties of conventional materials; an all-oxide all-solid-state sodium-ion battery; LTCC material with the industry's lowest dielectric loss tangent (company claim); semiconductor support glass, probe card substrates and inorganic core substrates for the semiconductor field; and low-dielectric and low-expansion glass fiber, which the company describes as indispensable for cutting-edge semiconductor materials.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 capital expenditure JPY 34,309 million, for capacity additions to expand sales, productivity-improving equipment renewal and periodic glass furnace repairs; in Electronics & Information Technology mainly the rollout of all-electric melting technology, capacity expansion and productivity investment in displays and capacity expansion in electronic devices. As of fiscal year-end the report lists no significant planned new facilities or retirements.
